name: catalog_search
description: Search what a look is made of: ops (by signature; kind lists them), blend modes, palettes and param kinds. Concise items give each one's kind, name, label and first sentence; detailed ones add its whole record: params with defaults and ranges, and examples as builder chains and as JSON, a layer's program (out and nodes: a look holds it as {"layers": [{"id": "base", ...program}]}) or, for a signal op, a whole look. A page holds 50 concise or 10 detailed items; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next. pewpew://catalog/{kind}/{name} holds one record whole.

query.description: Words that each must appear in a name, label or doc
query.title: Query

kind.description: Only one kind: op, blend, palette or kind (a param kind), or the ops of one signature: source, coord, color, combine, modulate, state or signal
kind.title: Kind

response_format.description: concise: kind, name, label and first sentence; detailed: also each whole record, with params and examples
response_format.title: Response Format

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the page before; omit for the first page
cursor.title: Cursor

CatalogItem.description:
One record found: its kind, name, label, first sentence and, for an
op, its signature (`source`, `coord`, ...); with `detail="detailed"`,
the whole record too.
CatalogItem.title: CatalogItem

name: look_check
description: Check a look, or a looks file, without rendering it: the aura's own checks, each problem with a code, its path (layers.base.osc.freq), a did-you-mean and a fix. A look that checks comes back normalized, every knob of every node written out with its value.

look.description: A look, {"layers": [...]}, bottom layer first, or a looks file, {"version": 4, "looks": {...}}. A layer is {"id", "nodes": {node id: {"op", "in": [node ids], "args": {...}}}}. A look may add "signals", {signal id: {"op", "args"}}, and "routes", [{"source": signal id, "path": knob address, "depth"}], that move knobs each frame.
look.title: Look

explain.description: Also describe the look in words, knob by knob; each look of a looks file
explain.title: Explain

Code.description: What kind of fix a problem needs. The values never change.
Code.title: Code

Problem.description:
One problem: where (`path`), what kind (`code`), why (`reason`, the
refusal's own words), the name it is closest to, the valid values, an
example of a valid value at `path` or None, and the edit that fixes it
in words (`fix`, made from the rest; None when only its reason can
say).
Problem.title: Problem

name: look_render
description: Render a look offline, as the aura runs it, and measure the frames. Returns a handle (r1-...) that look_compare and pewpew://render/{handle}/sheet.png take; the metrics (flash_rate_max at most 3 per second, mean_luma, black_fraction, clip_fraction, motion_energy, frozen_fraction, palette_spread, ...); warnings, such as a gate the look would fail; and a contact sheet of the frames. Read the metrics before the image. The same arguments always give the same handle and frames.

look.description: A look, {"layers": [...]}, bottom layer first, or a looks file, {"version": 4, "looks": {...}}. A layer is {"id", "nodes": {node id: {"op", "in": [node ids], "args": {...}}}}. A look may add "signals", {signal id: {"op", "args"}}, and "routes", [{"source": signal id, "path": knob address, "depth"}], that move knobs each frame.
look.title: Look

map.description: Where it renders: line:N, grid:WxH, lattice:N, or an arrangement file (.json)
map.title: Map

seconds.description: Seconds to render; flashing needs at least 1
seconds.title: Seconds

seed.description: Seeds the stand-in audio and room features (`run --seed`)
seed.title: Seed

sheet.description: Also return the frames as a contact sheet image
sheet.title: Sheet

response_format.description: concise: handle, metrics and warnings; detailed: also the render spec, with the whole look normalized
response_format.title: Response Format

Metrics.description:
What `measure` found in one sequence. Luma (Y) is 0-1; a fraction
is a share of samples (or of frame steps) from 0 to 1.
Metrics.title: Metrics

RenderSpec.description:
What a render depends on, normalized: the look (looks-file form,
every param written out), the map spec and what it gave (points, axes
spanned), seconds, fps, the frame count, the features' seed, and the
engine fingerprint.
RenderSpec.title: RenderSpec

name: look_compare
description: How render B differs from render A: each knob, signal, route or front list that differs, by its path; RMS and largest difference of the frames; the first frame that differs; each metric of B less A's; and a sheet with rows A and B at the same times. A look renders as the other side was rendered (map, seconds, fps, seed); two looks both render on `map`. The numbers are evidence, never a verdict.

a.description: A render handle (r1-...) from look_render, or a look to render as the other side was
a.title: A

b.description: A render handle (r1-...) from look_render, or a look to render as the other side was
b.title: B

map.description: Where it renders: line:N, grid:WxH, lattice:N, or an arrangement file (.json)
map.title: Map

Change.description:
One knob or field whose value differs: its path, its value in A and
its value in B (None where that side has none).
Change.title: Change

name: look_vary
description: Make n looks from a seed: from nothing, or like `look` at `strength`, holding the addresses in `keep`. Each is judged on the map before it is given (it checks, flashes at most 3 times a second, is not black, and every knob changes the picture), then rendered: each candidate gives its look, its own seed, its render handle (for look_compare and pewpew://render/{handle}/sheet.png), its metrics, and `taste`, the taste gates its render fails (too dark, washed out, dies out, frozen, noise, grey), which a made look avoids when it can. The sheet shows them in rows numbered 1 to n, at the same times. The same arguments always give the same looks.

look.description: The look to make looks like, as look_check takes it; omit it to make looks from nothing
look.title: Look

seed.description: The seed the looks are made from; the same seed gives the same looks
seed.title: Seed

strength.description: How far each look moves from `look`, above 0 and at most 1: 1 changes it most
strength.title: Strength

keep.description: Addresses of `look` to hold as they are, with all under them: a knob (layers.base.osc.freq), a node (layers.base.osc), a layer (layers.base) or a signal (signals.lfo)
keep.title: Keep

map.description: Where it renders: line:N, grid:WxH, lattice:N, or an arrangement file (.json)
map.title: Map

audio.description: Let a made look follow the sound (offline, the stand-in audio)
audio.title: Audio

sheet.description: Also return the frames as a contact sheet image
sheet.title: Sheet

Candidate.description:
One look `vary` made: the seed that made it, the look (looks-file
form, every knob written out), its render (handle, metrics and
warnings), and the taste gates the render fails (module docstring).
Candidate.title: Candidate

Metrics.description:
What `measure` found in one sequence. Luma (Y) is 0-1; a fraction
is a share of samples (or of frame steps) from 0 to 1.
Metrics.title: Metrics

name: engine_observe
description: Watch a running engine without changing it: its aura state (layers, master, whether a crossfade runs), status, every knob's value by address, health, the metrics of the frames it streams for `seconds` of engine time, and a contact sheet of them. The numbers are approximate: the frames arrive as 8-bit display gamma, and a large map is decimated. `faded` says a crossfade ran in the window, so the frames mix two looks: observe again once it ends.

url.description: The engine's preview address, as its `preview at` line prints it
url.title: Url

seconds.description: Seconds of engine time to watch
seconds.title: Seconds

sheet.description: Also return the frames as a contact sheet image
sheet.title: Sheet

Metrics.description:
What `measure` found in one sequence. Luma (Y) is 0-1; a fraction
is a share of samples (or of frame steps) from 0 to 1.
Metrics.title: Metrics

name: fleet_status
description: List each WLED board that answers on the network, by address: its name, MAC, WLED version, whether it shows a live stream and from where, its signal, free memory and uptime, and a health level with reasons and a fix. Reads only; takes a few seconds.

subnet.description: The network to scan, a /22 or smaller; default this machine's /24
subnet.title: Subnet

name: engine_apply
description: Send a whole look to an engine on this machine run with --preview --accept-looks, which fades to it over `fade` seconds (the look's own fade when none is given; the message says how long) and answers ack or refused. Observing during the fade measures both looks. The look is checked here first. A dry run (the default) checks the look against this machine's catalog and that the engine is on this machine, and shows the message it would send; the engine's map and --accept-looks are checked only on a send. Call again with dry_run false to send it, which appends an audit record first.

url.description: The engine's preview address, as its `preview at` line prints it
url.title: Url

look.description: A look, {"layers": [...]}, bottom layer first, or a looks file, {"version": 4, "looks": {...}}. A layer is {"id", "nodes": {node id: {"op", "in": [node ids], "args": {...}}}}. A look may add "signals", {signal id: {"op", "args"}}, and "routes", [{"source": signal id, "path": knob address, "depth"}], that move knobs each frame.
look.title: Look

fade.description: Seconds to fade over; default the look's own fade
fade.title: Fade

dry_run.description: Check and show what would be sent, and send nothing; false to send
dry_run.title: Dry Run

Answer.description:
The engine's answer to one message: an `ack`, or a refusal with its
reason and the address of what it refused (None when no one part is
to blame).
Answer.title: Answer

name: engine_set
description: Set one knob of the look an engine on this machine runs, by its address; the engine checks the knob and the value against its look and answers ack or refused. A dry run (the default) checks that the engine is on this machine and that the address has a knob's form, and shows the message; whether the look has that knob and takes the value is checked only on a send (engine_observe lists every knob and its value). Call again with dry_run false to send it, which appends an audit record first.

url.description: The engine's preview address, as its `preview at` line prints it
url.title: Url

path.description: A knob's address: layers.<layer>.<node>.<arg>, layers.<layer>.opacity or signals.<signal>.<arg>
path.title: Path

value.description: The knob's new value, as JSON: a number, a choice key, true or false
value.title: Value

dry_run.description: Check and show what would be sent, and send nothing; false to send
dry_run.title: Dry Run

Answer.description:
The engine's answer to one message: an `ack`, or a refusal with its
reason and the address of what it refused (None when no one part is
to blame).
Answer.title: Answer

name: engine_rename
description: Rename a saved look in the looks file of an engine on this machine run with --preview --accept-looks; the look keeps its place, and the engine refuses a name that is taken, an unknown look, or a look a trigger names, and answers ack or refused. A dry run (the default) checks both names and that the engine is on this machine, and shows the message; the engine's looks file is checked only on a send. Call again with dry_run false to send it, which appends an audit record first.

url.description: The engine's preview address, as its `preview at` line prints it
url.title: Url

name.description: A saved look's name: 1 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit
name.title: Name

to.description: A saved look's name: 1 to 32 letters, digits, spaces, '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit
to.title: To

dry_run.description: Check and show what would be sent, and send nothing; false to send
dry_run.title: Dry Run

Answer.description:
The engine's answer to one message: an `ack`, or a refusal with its
reason and the address of what it refused (None when no one part is
to blame).
Answer.title: Answer
